answer: The grading quorum of 8 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so an adversary cannot sit on the panel that judges it. The cipher assignment is published and juniper records each panel. Shards are assigned from the forge graph, as a result cluster membership directly reduces grading power. A farm of 3750 identities would post 4848 proofs and burn roughly 14 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
